content:
Unit 7 - Data + Text Integration — Title & Goal
Learn to master unit 7 - data + text integration questions for the Digital SAT through a short concept, a modeled item, and targeted practice.

Key skill

Read the note and focus on what the question is really asking inside the passage.

  • Locate explicit claims and implicit ideas.
  • Ask: What is the passage mainly doing?
  • Match answers to the most general accurate statement.

Model item

Study how the evidence in the passage supports the correct answer.

Chart (described) — A line graph shows bike commuters rising from 8% to 14% over five years.

Question 1. Which choice is supported by the graph?

  • Commuters decreased by half.
  • Bike commuting rose over the period.
  • There were no changes.
  • Bike commuting fell sharply.
Line increases → B.

Quick practice

Try these quickly. Eliminate two choices before choosing your answer.

Graph — Bars: A=40, B=40, C=60.

Question 2. Which choice accurately compares categories?

  • A equals B and both are less than C.
  • A is greater than C.
  • B is twice C.
  • C is smallest.

Next skill

Build on the previous skill. Compare how this question type reads the passage differently.

Note: Locate the exact phrase or sentence that proves your choice.

Another model item

Notice how small wording differences change the best answer.

Caption — ‘Respondents could select more than one option.’

Question 3. Which inference is most supported?

  • Totals may exceed 100%.
  • Totals must be under 50%.
  • Only one option allowed.
  • No one responded.

More practice

Aim for accuracy first, then speed. Re-check the evidence that rules out each wrong choice.

Table — Columns show temperature and ice cream sales increasing together.

Question 4. Which statement is supported?

  • Higher temperature is the sole cause of sales.
  • Sales and temperature are positively associated.
  • Sales cause warmer weather.
  • They are unrelated.

Mixed practice set

These mix multiple skills. Mark the question type before you start, then solve.

Graph — A dip in year 3 followed by recovery in year 4.

Question 5. Which is accurate?

  • Continuous decline.
  • Drop then rebound.
  • Flat line.
  • Immediate spike then plateau.
